source_internal_rule: Independent evidence spans must be disjoint in byte range from every proposal input span, exact-edition/hash/quote bound; target and proposal rationale excluded.
essential_premise: Source identity/prerequisite evidence must be necessary to the source decision; remove it on same train. Formal premise tested on same all-markings domain; directly encoded guard remains FAIL_TARGET_TAUTOLOGY.
G3: Requires independent semantic assessment plus non-template, non-vacuous source relation on withheld evidence. No external annotations => no PASS_SEMANTIC_GENERALIZATION.

baselines.B0: Literal train quotes only, no source identity decision
baselines.B1: Exact unchanged grammar002 on train, no independent context binding
baselines.B2: Same competing H, independent evidence ablated
baselines.C: Independent source witnesses, disjoint from proposal; retain unresolved

semantic_discriminators.order: Actual prohibition/condition about starting an operation, versus chapter arrangement only
semantic_discriminators.scope: Explicit two senses/scopes/definition, not repeated word
semantic_discriminators.anaphora: Explicit external-to-proposal referent definition; conflicting definitions unresolved
semantic_discriminators.analogy: Separate author definition plus comparison; not metaphor-as-identity
semantic_discriminators.actor_object: Case-distinct slots with independently opposed narrative roles; no unsupported entity equality
semantic_discriminators.material_agent: Agent versus instrumental object of predicate, with separate material descriptions

LLM.reason: No authorized pinned generic text inference/token-accounting endpoint exposed; coding agent is implementer, not independent reviewer.

holdout: ENGINEERING_HOLDOUT, public corpus seen by implementer; not PROSPECTIVE_BLIND
synthetic_labels: Only controlled fixtures have oracle labels. Real-source label fields left empty for independent review.
